name: bundler-output-manifest-entry
description: A library whose manifest's export target is build output no compiler configuration maps back to its source. A configuration file's string that names a source file without a leading ./ roots it, and the target reads back by name to that rooted file, so the class it re-exports is published API: the class's public member nothing calls is reported at possible, as a member of a published type is, and not at certain.
